basic_info.description: Outstanding Mid-Century, completely detached, 3- bedroom, 2-bath view home. Main floor has 2 bedrooms, large living room with picture window & fireplace, with nice views from Forest Hill to Mt. Davidson. Dining area opens into upgraded kitchen with sliding glass doors to a large view deck. Upgraded bathroom and sparkling, refinished hardwood floors complete this level. Garden level has a spacious room with sliding glass doors to the backyard, Art Deco-style full bath, laundry room and two-car, side-by-side parking. Fabulous location--short drive to Castro Village and West Portal shops & restaurants.
